facts.statement: SOE interrupted its services, including Free Realms, on April 21, 2011 following an external intrusion on its system.
facts.quote: As a result of an external intrusion on its system, SOE interrupted its services on April 21.

article_summaries.title: Sony Acknowledges "external intrusion" Responsible for MMO Downtime, PSN Still Out of Commission
article_summaries.summary: A Ten Ton Hammer news post (April 2011) on the PlayStation Network outage that stopped PS3 players of Free Realms and DC Universe Online from playing. It reports SOE's statement that services were interrupted on April 21 by an external intrusion, and that PSN was being rebuilt, so PS3 connections stayed down with no set return date. Free Realms is only a secondary subject here.
